prompt: Lou sells hot soup on a cold day
title: Hot Soup Day
irony: Lou charges extra for hot soup to keep his diner warm, yet the room warms only after he ladles the soup free and the town ladles kindness back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Cold wind whips the street outside Lou's Diner while a red pot steams in the window.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy craves hot soup and corrects Lou about soup facts while Benny sniffs the steam.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Sterling toots his truck horn across the road and lures the line with loud free crackers.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The diner crowd chants for hot soup while steam rises and spoons tap the bowls.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Lou charges extra for crackers and a big spoon while Teddy fears the sip feels too hot for his tongue.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Benny believes Sterling's wild tale and swaps his scarf for a cold cracker that snaps.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The diner crowd chants for hot soup while the red pot bubbles and rattles the lid.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lou holds the ladle and sees Murphy shiver outside with empty hands and a red nose.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lou lifts a full bowl toward Murphy and nods at Pearl with soft shining eyes.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Lou ladles free soup for the room and tastes the warmth spreading through the diner.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Steam curls over full bowls while neighbours trade scarves and sip shoulder to shoulder.
